step1.title: Add Streams
step1.description: Build your grid with live streams from Twitch, Kick, YouTube, or custom embed links on a single screen with direct connections to each platform.
step1.hint: Press {key} or click '+' in the right sidebar to add channels. Once multiple streams are open, drag tiles to reorder your grid or press F while hovering a stream to expand it.

step2.title: Chat Control
step2.description: Follow live messages from all your open streams in the right sidebar without switching windows.
step2.hint: Use the selector at the top of the chat panel to pick Unified Chat (which merges every stream in your grid into one reading feed), or press {keys} on your keyboard to jump to a single channel's chat and send messages.

step3.title: Twitch & Kick Accounts
step3.description: Link your accounts to participate in live chat with your favorite emotes and track your favorite channels right from the sidebar.
step3.twitchSub: Live chat, custom emotes & followed channels
step3.hint: Open Settings → Connections to sign in with Twitch or Kick. Connecting Twitch automatically populates the left sidebar with your followed channels that are currently live and unlocks 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ emotes in chat.

step4.title: Browse by Category
step4.description: See who is broadcasting right now on Twitch and Kick by filtering by game or category, without opening a browser to hunt for links.
step4.hint: Live suggestions appear on the home screen when your grid is empty and inside the Add Stream dialog ({key} key). Pick any category and click a live card to drop it straight into your grid.

step5.title: Live Transcription
step5.description: Generate live captions and optional English translation using Whisper directly on your CPU, 100% offline.
step5.hint: To set it up, open Settings → Transcription and download a local model (the Base model is best for most PCs). Then click the microphone icon in the right sidebar to show captions over the video and view the log in the Transcript tab.

step6.title: Local Recording
step6.description: Record any live broadcast from Twitch, Kick, or YouTube at original source quality, saved straight as MP4 files on your computer.
step6.hint: Enable the feature in Settings → Recording to install the recorder on first use. Then hover over any active stream and click the record button in the top player toolbar. You can also customize the output folder in Settings.

step7.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
step7.description: Manage your grid, jump between chats, and highlight streams quickly using the app's global keyboard shortcuts.
step7.focus: Expand hovered stream as main view
step7.hint: Shortcuts work anytime outside text inputs, even when your cursor is over a video player. You can reopen this guide whenever you need it under Settings → General → Show Onboarding Tour.
